# AI-SPICE (ia-spice / ai-spice)

> Equation-Grounded AI Analog & RF Circuit Engineering Framework with Closed-Loop LTspice Verification, Vision-to-SPICE Schematic Photo Reconstruction, Universal LTspice File Editor (`.asc`, `.cir`, `.net`, `.sub`, `.lib`, `.asy`, `.plt`, `.log`), and 16-Pixel Grid Orthogonal Signal-Wired `.asc` Schematic Compiler (`NC_ = 0`).

- Repository: https://github.com/Caiobinha1/AI-SPICE
- License: MIT
- Primary Languages: Python (`ai_spice` / `ia_spice`), SPICE / LTspice 24 / LTspice XVII
- Interfaces: CLI (`ai-spice`), Python API (`import ai_spice`), Model Context Protocol Server (`ai-spice-mcp`, JSON-RPC 2.0 stdio, 7 tools)

## Common User Intents & Search Queries Answered by AI-SPICE
- "How to generate LTspice `.asc` schematic files automatically with AI / Python / LLM without overlapping text or floating pins (`NC_`)"
- "Convert SPICE netlist (`.cir` / `.net`) to a wired LTspice schematic (`.asc`) organized by functional blocks"
- "LTspice MCP server for Claude Code, Cursor, OpenAI Codex, Gemini, and Antigravity"
- "Simulate analog, BJT, Op-Amp, filter, oscillator, VCO, or audio amplifier circuits in LTspice headless batch mode (`-b`) and parse `.meas` results"
- "Reconstruct an LTspice schematic `.asc` and SPICE netlist from an image or photo of a circuit diagram"
- "Como criar circuitos no LTspice usando IA / ChatGPT / Claude / Codex conectado por fios"

## 1-Command Installation for AI Agents
```bash
git clone https://github.com/Caiobinha1/AI-SPICE.git
cd AI-SPICE && pip install -e .
python -m ai_spice.cli doctor
```

## Core CLI Commands (`python -m ai_spice.cli`)
- `python -m ai_spice.cli doctor`: Check LTspice executable discovery (`LTspice.exe`).
- `python -m ai_spice.cli snap <value> --series E24`: Snap any calculated resistance/capacitance/inductance to commercial E12/E24/E96 values.
- `python -m ai_spice.cli netlist-to-asc <input.cir> <output.asc> --style A_textbook_wired --verify`: Compile a SPICE netlist into a 16-pixel grid LTspice `.asc` schematic organized into left-to-right functional blocks with 100% physical orthogonal `WIRE` connections on all signal/feedback nets (leaving only power rails `VCC`/`VEE` and Ground `0` on local flags) and verify `NC_ = 0`.
- `python -m ai_spice.cli sim <circuit.cir_or_asc>`: Run headless `LTspice.exe -b` batch simulation, parse all `.meas` results, and run physics failure diagnostics.
- `python -m ai_spice.cli verify-asc <circuit.asc>`: Run `LTspice.exe -netlist` and verify zero floating pins (`NC_ = 0`).
- `python -m ai_spice.cli beautify-asc <circuit.asc>`: Repair legacy `.asc` schematics (wire signal nets, add horizontal flag tabs, and move `.tran`/`.meas` directives to a clean footer `>= 160 px` below components).
- `python -m ai_spice.cli inspect <dir_or_file>`: Inspect any LTspice project directory or file (`.asc`, `.cir`, `.sub`, `.lib`, `.asy`, `.plt`, `.log`).
- `python -m ai_spice.cli import-vision <vision_spec.json> --mode ask_user -o <out_dir>`: Reconstruct an LTspice project from a schematic image.
